title: Banks Act Directive D2/2022 — Requirements for conducting the business of a representative office of a foreign banking institution conducting business in South Africa, and of a representative office of a South African bank conducting business outside South Africa
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Requirements for conducting the business of a representative office of a foreign banking institution conducting business in South Africa, and of a representative office of a South African bank conducting business outside South Africa.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Requirements for conducting the business of a representative office of a foreign banking institution conducting business in South Africa, and of a representative office of a South African bank conducting business outside South Africa.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Requirements for conducting the business of a representative office of a foreign banking institution conducting business in South Africa, and of a representative office of a South African bank conducting business outside South Africa. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
